_comment: HAND-MAINTAINED. Symbols moved or removed WITHOUT a prior deprecation (e.g. alpha features). generate_removals.py merges these into removals.json, so downstream tooling sees one removal history. Add a record here instead of editing removals.json, which is generated. Same fields as a removals.json record; deprecated_in and announced_removed_in are null because nothing was deprecated first.

relocations.subject: pipecat.processors.tone
relocations.message: `pipecat.processors.tone` was removed in 1.16.0 without a deprecation period (expressive conversation is alpha). Its contents moved to `pipecat.expressive.processors.tone_reader`, `pipecat.expressive.processors.tone_tagger` and `pipecat.classifiers.tone.model`.
